title: Evaluation of the effect of Cochlear Sound Processor upgrade (N6/N7 to N8)
summary:
The current model of the external speech processor for cochlear implant (CI) systems from the manufacturer Cochlear (Cochlear Nucleus 8, N8) has been on the market since October 2022. The new speech processor is designed to simplify conversation, particularly in situations with background noise. The aim of the study is to record the effects on CI wearers of an exchange (upgrade) from one of the predecessor models N6 and N7 to the current N8. Replacing the speech processors is a routine procedure. If patients already wear a CI, they can be fitted with a new speech processor after approx. 5-6 years if the technical requirements are met, even if the old one is still intact. Furthermore, the replacement is only carried out on the prescription of an ENT specialist who has experience with CI fitting. The prescription is only issued if it is expected that this will improve speech understanding. In the study, particular attention is paid not only to assessing speech understanding and listening effort before and after the replacement in the laboratory, but also in everyday life. For the latter, a smartphone app on study smartphones will be used to collect responses and assessments in the test subjects' everyday lives. A total of five clinics are to take part in this study.    
The participating CI users attend a total of three appointments at their clinic, as well as two 30-day trial phases at home between these appointments. The appointments at the clinic are a screening and recruitment appointment (first appointment), as well as two appointments to test speech understanding in quiet or in background noise before and after the upgrade to the new N8 speech processor. During the trial phases before and after the upgrade to N8, participants use the smartphone app to answer questions about their quality of life and satisfaction with the old and upgrade speech processors in everyday life in various situations.
conditions: Presence of otological and audiological implants

interventions.name:
Upgrade to the N8 speech processor (before and after observation) 
- Upgrade takes place at the second of three appointments
- Trial for 30+/-7 days, testing at the third appointment
- N8 speech processor is then returned

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- CI from the manufacturer Cochlear with a speech processor from the CP900 or CP1000 series (one or both sides)
- at least 5 years of hearing experience in the ear that is to be upgraded
- must be able to understand the purpose and risks of the study and provide signed and dated informed consent
- must be able to comply with study-related tests and procedures
- must speak German at an appropriate level so that the questionnaires can be answered independently
Exclusion criteria:
- in addition to the hearing impairment, no other disability, neurological disease or cognitive impairment that could have an influence on the course of the study or that would make the survey (app) too physically or mentally demanding
- Simultaneous participation in other studies that may overburden the test person or influence the study results
